summary: Staff car park beside a rail yard, no homes, flat.
reasons: Backs onto rail corridor and industry

best_section.where: North-west edge of the car park against the rail fence, east of the small depot building

drivers.seclusion: Rail tracks along one side, depot and warehouse on the others; no mapped buildings or homes nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed bays along the rail edge sit clear of the truck lane; cars already use them.
drivers.traffic: Trucks and trailers manoeuvre in the yard just south; the bays themselves are off the lane.
drivers.convention: Rows of parked cars in the imagery; looks like staff parking.

flags: Likely staff-only parking; may be patrolled
Gates at 37 m and 46 m have a way round
sun_shade: Open sky, no tree cover; the depot building shades the west end in the morning.
